<thought>The isotopic envelope shows a series of peaks spaced ~1 Da with intensities decreasing roughly by a factor of ~10 each step, which is characteristic of the natural 13C distribution in a molecule containing many carbon atoms. No distinct M+2 pattern (e.g., from Cl, Br, S) is observed, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
